name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Dashboard now shows a "Now watching" indicator: any session on this server currently playing an item federated in from a friend, with who's watching, which friend it came from, and playback progress. Backed by a new FederationNowWatchingService that reads ISessionManager.Sessions live (no separate state to keep in sync) and filters to sessions whose now-playing item carries a FederationKey provider id, reusing the existing "🌐 ServerName" tag already stamped on every federated item to label the source. Polls every 5s alongside the existing Downloads card; the section stays hidden entirely when nothing federated is playing. 243 tests, all green.
